key_idea: Bounding the Lie algebra's dimension by degenerating the pentagon relation modulo two, and matching this upper bound with characteristic-zero depth-one elements via a dimension squeeze over Z_{(2)}.
reason: The proof deploys a profoundly surprising and clever characteristic-two reduction to bound dimensions, unifying arithmetic methods with topological algebra. This beautiful conceptual core is structurally clear, though it necessarily carries a heavy and intricate technical apparatus of explicit commutators and filtrations.
recognized: Freeness of the Grothendieck-Teichmuller Lie algebra
